about.description: CAVA is an XRPL-issued token representing an economic interest in an Alter SPVs investment vehicle that holds an early-stage venture investment in Carbovanta Advanced Materials. Carbovanta develops graphene, carbon nanomaterials, conductive materials, coatings, thermal materials, and industrial carbon technologies for commercial applications. Carbovanta does not issue, administer, market, or operate the token, and the operating business remains entirely separate from the tokenization structure.
about.registryInfo: Alter SPVs is an early-stage venture investor in Carbovanta Advanced Materials and has tokenized its investment interest through a dedicated SPV on the XRP Ledger. The token represents an economic interest in the Alter SPVs investment vehicle rather than direct ownership of Carbovanta shares. Carbovanta Advanced Materials develops graphene, carbon nanomaterials, conductive materials, coatings, thermal materials, and industrial carbon technologies for commercial applications.
